title: Relative quasi-Gorenstein homological dimensions in extriangulated categories
summary: Let $(\mathcal{C},\mathbb{E},\mathfrak s)$ be an extriangulated category equipped with a proper class $ξ$ of $\mathbb E$-triangles.We establish stability under iteration for the quasi-$ξ$-Gorenstein projective and injective subcategories and extend the relative Ext-vanishing criteria for their finite homological dimensions to larger coefficient subcategories. An example in a bounded homotopy category shows that $\mathcal{P}(ξ)\subsetneq\mathcal{QGP}(ξ)\subsetneq\mathcal{GP}(ξ)$.
